Frequency once per day

You and your bonded ninken (or, until your animal companion ships, a phantom canine of equivalent size) spin into the Gatsūga: a twin drill of teeth and chakra. You both Stride up to your Speed in a straight line and may make a single melee Strike against each creature you pass through; the second Strike of this action gains the multiple-attack penalty.
